Some guidance...

_For planned and completed work, the release process for amdsiloai/pytorch-xdit images starts from branching main to a release branch `release/vXY.Z` which automatically instantiates our CI [pipeline]( CI pushes the release candidate to amdsiloai/pytorch-xdit-staging` after which it can be pulled and manually further validated to avoid regressions in functionality or performance. See our earlier performance [results]( for reference and add the results for the release candidate there. Finally, please list all features and fixes planned and implemented for this image release, because it is used to draft public release notes._
